target.route: HTTPS directly to the ALB origin, preserving the portal host/SNI
target.behavior: Read-only readiness query that checks PostgreSQL with SELECT 1

limitations: This validates 3000 concurrent virtual sessions on the read-only readiness path, not 3000 users exercising sales, ERP, or telephony transactions.
The test held the maximum VU count for one minute; it is not a long-duration soak test.

The 2-to-3 autoscaling policy transition was not tested. The ASG minimum is currently 3, and the CloudFormation stack is in UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED, so lowering capacity or changing the group directly would introduce risk/drift.
